import sys, os, time, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('f26d989f')
SRC = dict(r27=live, r28=open(_p.__file__).read())
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('rev28q4d_'+n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = dict((n, mk(n)) for n in SRC)
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))
def run(pages, people, allowed):
    b = rc.pages_pdf(pages); out = ''
    for n, m in M.items():
        r = in_process(m, b, people, Mock())
        out += 'W' if rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed) else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
    return out
X = 72
FLEET_EXTRA = dict(none=[], name_dan=[(282, 'Name: Dan Whaley', False, X)], name_blank=[(282, 'Name:', False, X)], name_title=[(282, 'Name: Dan Whaley', False, X), (294, 'Title: CEO', False, X)])
G = Counter(); t = time.time()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for fx, gap, sk, head, recital, signer, side in product(FLEET_EXTRA, (40, 80, 140), ('sig_text', 'by_text', 'conformed', 'blank'), ('For and on behalf of the Recipient', None, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.'), ('parsed', 'none'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'), ('stacked', 'side_by_side')):
        fleet = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X, 290)] + FLEET_EXTRA[fx] + [(310, 'Date:', True, X, 290)]
        if side == 'stacked':
            x0 = X; y0 = 310 + gap
        else:
            x0 = 340; y0 = 240 + gap - 40
        sr = dict(sig_text='Signature:', by_text='By:', conformed='/s/ Pat Smith', blank=None)[sk]
        own = ([(y0, head, False, x0)] if head else []) + ([(y0 + 30, sr, False, x0)] if sr else []) + [(y0 + 42, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, x0), (y0 + 54, 'Title: CEO', False, x0)]
        pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
        people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
        k = run([list(rc.RECITALS[recital]), fleet + own], people, dict([(rc.PE, (2, x0 - 10, y0 + 20, 612)), (rc.DE, (2, 0, 270, 300))]))
        G[(side, fx, k)] += 1
print('elapsed', round(time.time() - t), 'cells', sum(G.values()), 'http', http.call_count)
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
